originStory.title: Why I Built This
originStory.subtitle: From burnout to something that actually works
originStory.story: I didn't create the Knowledge Worker Kit because I'm naturally organized. I created it because I was drowning. As a shy, introverted teenager, I found refuge in writing and building websites. Decades later, I was still struggling. A failed startup cost me 200k euros and two years. I burned out trying to do everything through sheer willpower. The transition from introverted engineer to leader was painful. Three kids while building a business. Losing loved ones and questioning what really matters. These experiences forced me to build systems that actually work. Not theoretical frameworks, but practical systems I use every day. Today, I manage nearly 10,000 notes in my personal vault and I'm almost always calm, despite a demanding life. The Knowledge Worker Kit is everything I wish I had when I started. It's 20+ years of building systems, trial, error, and hard lessons distilled into something you can use.
originStory.inspirationPoint: The moment I realized I needed systems that worked even when motivation failed

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years of Building Systems
creatorJourney.subtitle: Not theory. Practice.
creatorJourney.story: I've been coding since age 8 and writing almost as long. In my IT career, I've been a software developer, technical lead, software architect, solution architect, infrastructure architect, IT security expert, team leader, project manager, CTO, and founder. Today, I work half-time as an IT Solution Architect for a major financial organization in Belgium while running DeveloPassion, raising 3 kids, and maintaining nearly 10,000 notes in my personal knowledge system. I've published 3 books, written 400+ articles and newsletters, created courses, built digital products, and launched the Knowii community. My system works. I want it to work for you too. This isn't content from someone who researched productivity for a blog post. This is a living system from someone who builds his life around these principles.

methodology.title: The Four Pillars
methodology.subtitle: How the system works

steps.title: Clarity First
steps.description: Before you can be productive, you need to know what matters. Define your values, principles, goals, and priorities. Without this foundation, all the systems in the world won't help. You'll just be efficiently doing the wrong things.

steps.title: Systems Beat Willpower
steps.description: Stop relying on motivation that comes and goes. Build habits, routines, and systems that make progress automatic. The best system is one that works even on your worst days.

steps.title: Knowledge as Leverage
steps.description: Your knowledge system is your advantage. Build a second brain that captures, organizes, and connects what you learn. Make your knowledge compound instead of fade away.

steps.title: Connect Everything
steps.description: Ideas in isolation have limited value. Link your knowledge, connect with your community, build relationships that create opportunities. Breakthroughs happen at intersections.

methodology.philosophy: Clarity creates direction. Systems create consistency. Knowledge creates leverage. Connection creates opportunities.
methodology.differentiation: This isn't another productivity course. It's a comprehensive system built from 20+ years of practice. Every topic covered, every piece connected, continuously updated, supported by a community of practitioners.
